stories.title: Late stop helps No. 11 Notre Dame hand No. 1 Miami first loss of season
Notre Dame fends off Miami rally to dethrone top-ranked Canes
stories.summary: Notre Dame avenged a loss that torpedoed its CFP hopes last year with a 31-24 victory over the previously unbeaten Hurricanes.

stories.title: Fourth-down flops doom LSU in 'really disappointing' loss to Alabama
stories.summary: In a matchup of CFP hopefuls, No. 14 LSU outgained No. 5 Alabama by 172 yards but was undone by poor red zone and fourth-down offense, losing at home 31-13 to fall to 6-3 this season, an outcome Tigers coach Lane Kiffin called "really disappointing."

stories.title: Day laments Ohio State must 'weather the storm' as Big Ten, CFP hopes crumble
stories.summary: Ryan Day acknowledged after Ohio State's 41-28 loss to Oregon that having three losses in a season with faint CFP hopes was "not someplace we thought we'd be."

stories.title: Messi makes history as 1st back-to-back MLS Golden Boot winner
stories.summary: Lionel Messi has become the first player to win back-to-back MLS Golden Boot awards after the Inter Miami forward finished the regular season with 26 goals.
